name: Alpha Numeric Glossary
description: Adds an A-Z / 0-9 glossary of letter and number links to the global (header/footer) area of any View.
project_description: Alpha Numeric Glossary provides a Views global-area handler that renders an alphabetical/numeric index (A-Z, 0-9, plus optional 'All') in the header or footer of any View display. Each character becomes a link that scopes the listing to entries whose chosen field begins with that letter or digit; characters with no matching content are rendered as inactive (non-linked) items and can optionally be hidden or shown with per-character result counts. It works against nodes, users, taxonomy terms, comments and media, grouping on a text/string field (or the base 'title'/'name' property), and pairs with a Views contextual filter in Glossary mode to do the actual filtering. It ships a Views area plugin (Global: Alpha Numeric Glossary), a Views field plugin for grouping rows by their first character, a helper service, alterable alphabets/numbers hooks, and tokens for building the link paths. No routes, permissions, or admin settings form of its own — all configuration lives in the View handler's options form.
